{{Top|leg|title=Unidentified ''Arcanum'' guard}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''guard''' stationed on the ''[[Arcanum]]'', a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that served as a repository for [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]], betrayed the Empire and allowed the servants of the [[Dread Masters]] to locate and [[Raid on the Arcanum|raid]] the station. After the attack, the guard was captured and tortured as to the plans of Lord [[Tagriss]], who had led the attack.
